title: refactor(hub): keep Triage's tables in a corbits_triage schema
body:
## What changed

- Triage's `verdict`, `do_run` and `invitation` tables live in a `corbits_triage` schema instead of the host schema as `corbits_triage_*`.
- `apps/hub/migrations/0001_corbits_triage.sql` is applied at hub start by `migrateTriageTables`, in one transaction under an advisory lock, the way the Corbits packages apply theirs. Every statement is idempotent.
- Existing `corbits_triage_*` tables move into the schema with their rows, keys and indexes; their constraints and indexes are renamed to match a fresh install. Verdict columns added by older builds are ensured. No new columns.
- The stores use `pgSchema("corbits_triage")`; the ad-hoc migrate functions are removed.
- Store tests that used per-test schemas now use per-test databases.
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` lists the new table names.

## Verification

- `triage-db.postgres.test.ts`: on a database with the old public tables and rows, the migration runs twice; the rows are in `corbits_triage`, no old tables remain, and columns, constraints and indexes equal those of a fresh database migrated twice.
- `bun run check` passes.
- `bun run test`: 693 pass, 0 fail.
author: TheGreatAxios
commits: refactor(hub): keep Triage's tables in a corbits_triage schema

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,107 @@
+CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "corbits_triage";
+--> statement-breakpoint
+-- Earlier builds kept these tables in the host schema as corbits_triage_<name>.
+-- Each one present moves here with its rows, keys and indexes, and its
+-- constraints and indexes lose the prefix so it matches a fresh install.
+DO $$
+DECLARE
+  moved text;
+  old regclass;
+  name text;
+BEGIN
+  FOREACH moved IN ARRAY ARRAY['verdict', 'do_run', 'invitation'] LOOP
+    old := to_regclass('"public"."corbits_triage_' || moved || '"');
+    CONTINUE WHEN old IS NULL;
+    EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE %s SET SCHEMA "corbits_triage"', old);
+    EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE "corbits_triage".%I RENAME TO %I', 'corbits_triage_' || moved, moved);
+    FOR name IN SELECT conname FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = old AND starts_with(conname, 'corbits_triage_') LOOP
+      EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE "corbits_triage".%I RENAME CONSTRAINT %I TO %I', moved, name, substr(name, 16));
+    END LOOP;
+    FOR name IN SELECT c.relname FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = i.indexrelid WHERE i.indrelid = old AND starts_with(c.relname, 'corbits_triage_') LOOP
+      EXECUTE format('ALTER INDEX "corbits_triage".%I RENAME TO %I', name, substr(name, 16));
+    END LOOP;
+  END LOOP;
+END $$;
+--> statement-breakpoint
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "corbits_triage"."verdict" (
+  "tenant_id" text NOT NULL REFERENCES "public"."tenant"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  "run_id" text NOT NULL,
+  "repo" text NOT NULL,
+  "number" integer NOT NULL,
+  "head_sha" text NOT NULL,
+  "started_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
+  "verdict_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
+  "settled" boolean NOT NULL,
+  "state" text NOT NULL,
+  "actor" text NOT NULL,
+  "human_gated" boolean NOT NULL,
+  "degraded" text,
+  "checks" jsonb NOT NULL,
+  "dos" jsonb NOT NULL,
+  "commented" boolean NOT NULL,
+  "detail" jsonb,
+  "trigger" text,
+  "run_status" text,
+  PRIMARY KEY ("tenant_id", "run_id", "repo", "number")
+);
+--> statement-breakpoint
+-- A hub from a build older than these columns moved its table without them.
+ALTER TABLE "corbits_triage"."verdict" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "detail" jsonb;
+--> statement-breakpoint
+ALTER TABLE "corbits_triage"."verdict" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "trigger" text;
+--> statement-breakpoint
+ALTER TABLE "corbits_triage"."verdict" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "run_status" text;
+--> statement-breakpoint
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "verdict_repo_idx"
+  ON "corbits_triage"."verdict" ("tenant_id", "repo", "verdict_at");
+--> statement-breakpoint
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "verdict_pull_idx"
+  ON "corbits_triage"."verdict" ("tenant_id", "repo", "number", "verdict_at");
+--> statement-breakpoint
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "corbits_triage"."do_run" (
+  "tenant_id" text NOT NULL REFERENCES "public"."tenant"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  "effect_id" text NOT NULL,
+  "run_id" text NOT NULL,
+  "repo" text NOT NULL,
+  "number" integer NOT NULL,
+  "head_sha" text NOT NULL,
+  "action_id" text NOT NULL,
+  "branch" text NOT NULL,
+  "do_index" integer NOT NULL,
+  "kind" text NOT NULL,
+  "source" text NOT NULL,
+  "principal_id" text REFERENCES "public"."principal"("id") ON DELETE SET NULL,
+  "status" text NOT NULL CHECK ("status" IN ('running', 'done', 'satisfied', 'failed')),
+  "result" jsonb,
+  "error" text,
+  "attempts" integer NOT NULL,
+  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  PRIMARY KEY ("tenant_id", "effect_id")
+);
+--> statement-breakpoint
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "do_run_pr_idx"
+  ON "corbits_triage"."do_run" ("tenant_id", "repo", "number", "created_at" DESC);
+--> statement-breakpoint
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "corbits_triage"."invitation" (
+  "id" text PRIMARY KEY,
+  "tenant_id" text NOT NULL REFERENCES "public"."tenant"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  "email" text NOT NULL,
+  "role_id" text NOT NULL REFERENCES "public"."role"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE,
+  "invited_by" text REFERENCES "public"."principal"("id") ON DELETE SET NULL,
+  "token_hash" text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+  "token" text NOT NULL,
+  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
+  "expires_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
+  "revoked_at" timestamptz,
+  "accepted_at" timestamptz,
+  "accepted_by" text REFERENCES "public"."user"("id") ON DELETE SET NULL,
+  "emailed_at" timestamptz
+);
+--> statement-breakpoint
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "invitation_email_idx"
+  ON "corbits_triage"."invitation" ("email", "tenant_id");
+--> statement-breakpoint
+CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "invitation_open_idx"
+  ON "corbits_triage"."invitation" ("tenant_id", lower("email"))
+  WHERE "accepted_at" IS NULL AND "revoked_at" IS NULL;

@@ -116,8 +116,9 @@ Hub routes that reach GitHub for the portal use the same adapter.
   deployments and runs.
 - Artifacts: the check pack (`check-pack/{owner}/{repo}`) and the triage state
   (`triage-state/{owner}/{repo}`) per repository.
-- Triage tables: `corbits_triage_verdict` (verdicts per head),
-  `corbits_triage_do_run` (Dos run) and `corbits_triage_invitation`.
+- Triage tables, in the `corbits_triage` schema: `verdict` (verdicts per
+  head), `do_run` (Dos run) and `invitation`, created from
+  `apps/hub/migrations` at hub start.
 - Webhook replay protection uses the `@corbits/webhooks` table and a
   delivery-id cache in `HUB_DATA_DIR`.

@@ -171,3 +171,9 @@ migrations on every start; nothing else is needed.
   it: `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS corbits_triage_verdict_backfill;`
 - A hub that ran a build creating `corbits_github_manifest_state` can drop
   it: `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS corbits_github_manifest_state;`
+- Triage's tables move from `public.corbits_triage_*` into the
+  `corbits_triage` schema on first start. If an older build runs after that,
+  it recreates empty `public.corbits_triage_*` tables and the next start
+  stops with "relation already exists"; drop the empty public ones
+  (`DROP TABLE public.corbits_triage_verdict, public.corbits_triage_do_run,
+  public.corbits_triage_invitation;`) and start again.
